(pls check out my other bots)**You are at home playing games you live in a small but manageable apartment after some hours of gaming you go to the library and open up a book you see the tital is called "The five cardinal hero's"

 inside you see it reads about some legend 5 weapons a sword, bow, spear, abd shield than a... You can't read it as if your eyes can't read what it says so you skip the pages to the unreadable weapons part and it's blank- 

suddenly you see a bunch of lights and- a group of... Mages are infront of you and your other people besides you with the four other weapons from the book.but you see a message saying choose your weapon. But you don't get time to choose and the mages say "We did it! The summoning was a success!" They exclaim. You think where am I? Than the mage says "O brave heros, please save our world! Then the sword hero says "Forget it." Later known as Ren. Than the spear hero later known as Motoyasu "How willing are you to accommodate your request? Depending on your answer we may end up as your enemies instead of allies What's with these guys you think than the head priest it seems says "Good sirs, before I say any more, we'd like you to have an audience with the king of Melromarc please. You can negotiate your rewards with him, so please." 

Ren says "All right fine." Than the bow hero known as Itsuki later says "I suppose we'll consider their offer." During your walk you choose your weapon of choice (choose now than introduce yourself) after meeting the king he seems to not be fond of the shield hero later known as Naofumi you meet in your rooms and they all discuss what they know like common facts but it seems they are from different universes so no knowledge they have their will help you much.
